featured_reviews.review_text:
We have visited this place multiple times, when it comes to chinese food this is best option nearby, Well we have decided to celebrate my In-laws wedding anniversary over there however we had very disappointing experience. We went to FOC expecting to try several dishes listed on the menu, but most of them were not available. Nearly every time we ordered something, the staff said it was “not available today,” which made the menu feel pointless. Not even fried noodles which is basis in any Chinese restaurant was not available. Their special dishes was not available

After going through multiple options, we were left with only a few basic choices. It was frustrating because we specifically came to try certain dishes, but the restaurant couldn’t provide them. If a restaurant lists items on the menu, they should actually have them available.

Overall, poor planning and a very unsatisfying experience. I wouldn’t recommend coming here unless you’re okay with most of the menu being unavailable. Pathetic service we have experience on our special day. If they don't know how to handle Online order along with restaurant they should not run restaurant, either run dining or cloud kitchen. Not going to visit nor recommending this place any more.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul (Space_racer)
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hit-and-miss experience; Great Kebabs but lacking variety
Rating: ⭐⭐⭐ (3/5)
Su Swagat is a typical Udupi-run establishment located in Borivali East. While there are some highlights, the overall experience was a bit of a mixed bag for me.
The Good:
Tandoori Chicken Tangdi Kebab: This was the star of the meal! Surprisingly great, well-marinated, and cooked to perfection. If you visit, this is definitely a must-try.
Service: Being an Udupi-managed place, the service is generally quick and efficient.
The Not-So-Good:
Ambience: The interiors feel a bit dated and could definitely use an upgrade to make the dining experience more comfortable and inviting.
Dal Khichadi: Quite ordinary. It lacked the soulful, comforting flavor you’d expect from a staple dish.
Menu Options: As a diner in Maharashtra, I was quite let down to find Maharashtrian cuisine completely missing from the menu. Given the location and the competition, adding some local flavors would go a long way.
Final Verdict:
Go here for the Tandoori starters, but don't expect much in terms of local Maharashtrian food or fancy vibes. It's an okay spot for a quick, no-frills meal.

featured_reviews.name: Harshad Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Jai Jalaram's Tasty Ice Bhel in Mulund West and I must say, it exceeded my expectations. At Rs. 40, this street food snack is an absolute steal!

The ice bhel was a refreshing twist on the classic bhel puri, with a unique combination of sweet and savory flavors. The coolness of the cool icy chatni complemented the spicy and tangy flavors of the bhel perfectly, making for a delicious and satisfying snack.

The portion size was average, and the ingredients were fresh and flavorful. I especially loved the crunch of the sev and the juicy bursts of flavor from the pomegranate seeds.

The staff was friendly and attentive, and the stall was clean and well-maintained. Overall, Jai Jalaram's Tasty Ice Bhel is a must-try for anyone looking for a tasty and affordable street food snack in Mulund West. I highly recommend it!

The bhel was a perfect blend of moist and juicy ingredients, complemented by the rich flavors of date tamarind chutney and garlic chutney. The Pani Puri was a standout, offering a burst of flavors with amazing hot water, sprouts, and soaked boondi.

What truly impressed me was the affordability – at just 40 Rs. per plate, it's unquestionably a great value for money. The quality of ingredients and the attention to detail in preparation make Jai Jalaram Ice Bhel a go-to spot for those seeking a satisfying and budget-friendly street food experience. I highly recommend trying it for a delightful taste of authentic flavors without breaking the bank.

featured_reviews.name: Aayushi Parikh
featured_reviews.review_text: This outlet continues to serve some of the most delicious and irresistible sandwiches I’ve ever had. Their menu offers such a wide variety that it’s hard to pick just one favorite, and I’ve enjoyed countless meals here over the years. While the outlet operates as a self-service place and doesn’t provide the most comfortable dining experience, this hasn’t stopped people from loving their food. In fact, it’s one of the reasons many customers prefer ordering delivery from here. This place is truly a hidden gem in Borivali, and I’ve been a loyal customer since the days when they operated as a humble roadside stall. I’ve personally witnessed their incredible journey from a small stall to a café and now a franchise. Despite their growth and fame, what stands out the most is that their taste has remained consistent and just as amazing as it was back in the day. Although I’ve never reviewed them before, this has always been my go-to sandwich spot. My personal favorite is their Dharma Special Sandwich, which is loaded with fresh vegetables, creamy mayo, and gooey cheese, as well as their Chocolate Sandwich, which is a delightful treat. However, I’ve tried almost everything on their menu, and I can honestly say that every item is delicious. I haven’t had the chance to try their drinks yet, so I can’t comment on that, but for sandwiches, this place is an absolute must-visit.  Next time I'll take the photos of ambience and all.
